title: Fancy ArmorViewer
description: Displays the current armor usage (wear) of nearby players above their head, making it easy to know how close their armor is to breaking.
body:
Armor Viewer

Armor Viewer is a lightweight client-side Java mod that shows the durability of your opponent's equipped armor directly above their head.

Instead of opening inventories or trying to estimate armor damage, you can instantly see how worn their gear is while fighting.

Features
🛡️ Displays armor durability above players.
⚔️ Perfect for PvP and competitive gameplay.
👀 Easy-to-read floating armor icons.
🚀 Lightweight and optimized.
Why use this mod?

Knowing how damaged an opponent's armor is can help you make better decisions during combat. The information is displayed in a clean, non-intrusive way, so you can stay focused on the fight.

Whether you're playing on PvP servers or just want more information during battles, this mod provides a simple and convenient solution.
